title.narrative: Bangladesh: Rural Electricity Transmission and Distribution Project

description.narrative: The objectives of the Rural Electricity Transmission and Distribution Project for Bangladesh are to reduce system losses and enhance capacity in the rural distribution network of primarily the eastern part of the country. The project is implemented through the following components: 1) rural grid augmentation and rehabilitation; 2) transmission enhancement; and 3) institutional strengthening. The first component supports the augmentation and rehabilitation needs of thirty-nine Palli Biddyut Samities (PBSs) - rural electric cooperatives - in the eastern part of Bangladesh. The second component identifies substations that will be needed for the rural distribution network in the project areas and ensures their effective functioning and transmission capacities. The final component supports various institutional strengthening needs as and when necessary.
The proposed Project development objectives are to reduce system losses and enhance capacity in the rural distribution network of primarily the eastern part of Bangladesh.

title.narrative: Electricity losses per year in the project area

comment.narrative: <p>Losses in the project area decreased to 7.6% in February 2020 but increased to 9.2% in December 2020 due to COVID. Demand a nd sales revenue decreased and utilization of the expanded network reduced. COVID-19 positivity increased in the last 3 months again (number of new cases and daily deaths) resulting in frequent, strict and wider lockdowns. This trend may continue and w ill impact economy, jobs, manufacturing, cultivation, people's income, purchasing power, mobility, and education. Demand f or electricity and sales revenue and utilization of network will reduce. Otherwise, the losses may reduce to as low as 7% at e nd of the year.</p>
<p>Estimated about 5 million new households (25.12 million new beneficiaries) are receiving benefits of electricity supply sin ce the project constructed the enhanced network.</p>

title.narrative: Financial sustainability of the PBSs ensured

comment.narrative: <p>A draft tariff study of BREB/PBSs has been reviewed. The scope of the work includes- i) review of existing tariff methodolo gy and identification of scope for potential improvements and enhancements, ii) preliminary assessment of financial performanc e of PBSsand potential for cost reductions to offset the need for tariff increases, if any, and iii) calculation of indicativ e tariffs for PBSs under various potential enhancements as per methodology and assumptions on cost improvements. Finally, the consultants may recommend a future tariff calculation methodology for BREB/PBSs. The recommendations will help BREB prepare a tariff proposal based on a set methodology for consideration of BERC. BREB may take up the revised methodology for BERC's review/advice. The recommendations will also help BREB in getting cost reduction by enhancing performances of PBSs and making them financially efficient.</p>

actual.value: BREB has reviewed a draft final report and given comments. BREB is waiting for presentation of a revised report with necessary improvements in a workshop/virtual conference for finalization. BREB also expects to receive relevant software.

title.narrative: Design for an appropriate Quality and Reliability Indicators at BREB

comment.narrative: <p>BREB has completed the study on SAIDI and SAIFI, SCADA & Network Protection. This provides a design for Quality and Rel iability Indicators for BREB. BREB is using this in one pilot SCADA under implementation in one substation with own funding. At present BREB has no automated method to measure SAIDI and SAIFI which they can agree with Power Division under KPI. Manual method to calculate SAIDI and SAIFI is used which is susceptible to errors. Under EDMP, the task team has initiated discussions with BREB to prepare technical appraisal and learnt about BREB plan on automation, design/monitoring Q&R of supply, how they intend to establish a control and a call center to respond to customers' complaints. BREB will pursue the automation and ADMS and integrate several modules to make one PBS operational for automated operation and a smart grid and will th en replicate the experience. The activity will continue after project closing.</p>

actual.value: Design completed and in use in a pilot SCADA funded by BREB. This will continue after the Closing date. Upon successful completion and automated operation, BREB will replicate the experience in other substations and include the indicators in Annual Reports.

comment.narrative: <p>BREB reform plan is approved and implemented. BREB completed recruitment of additional staff as per the BREB reform plan. T hey are working at different places and positions of BREB and PBSs. Given enhanced work volume generated by the Universal acce ss agenda(BREB already met 99.5%), BREB's enhanced manpower supported by the reform plan has been justified, these people have been trained on a number of skills/ fields (financial management and accounting and automation, REB master plan review,< br /> network planning using load flow, procurement, project implementation, GIS design, development and implementation, impro ved materials specifications, management and standards, improved network protection, performance, and reliability; BREB/PBSs o perations etc.</p>
